steps.title: Welcome, Admin! 👋
steps.intro: This is your AFPAConnect admin dashboard. Let's take a quick tour so you know where everything lives.

steps.title: Navigation Sidebar
steps.intro: Everything you need is here in the sidebar. Manage franchises, users, leads, analytics, and more — all from one place.

steps.title: Franchise Listings
steps.intro: Add, edit, and manage all franchise brands on the platform. Control which listings are active and featured in the directory.

steps.title: User Management
steps.intro: View all registered users, change their roles, and associate franchisors with their brand listing.

steps.title: Leads & Advisors
steps.intro: Track incoming leads and manage your advisor network from here.

steps.title: Analytics
steps.intro: Monitor platform-wide performance — quiz completions, lead volume, and franchise engagement.

steps.title: Platform Guide
steps.intro: New to something? The Platform Guide has step-by-step instructions for every admin task.

steps.title: You're all set! 🚀
steps.intro: You have full control of the platform. If you ever need a refresher, click Reset Tour in Settings.

steps.title: Welcome to your Franchisor Dashboard! 🏢
steps.intro: This is your home base for managing your franchise presence on AFPAConnect. Let's show you around.

steps.title: Your Dashboard
steps.intro: The sidebar gives you quick access to every section of your franchisor portal.

steps.title: My Listings
steps.intro: View and edit your franchise listing — update your description, gallery images, investment details, and more.

steps.title: Leads
steps.intro: See every prospect who has expressed interest in your franchise. Follow up and track their status here.

steps.title: Analytics
steps.intro: Connect your marketing platforms — Google My Business, Meta Ads, Google Analytics — and track all performance in one place.

steps.title: Settings
steps.intro: Update your account details and notification preferences here.

steps.title: Ready to grow! 🎉
steps.intro: Your dashboard is set up. Start by reviewing your listing to make sure it's looking its best for prospective franchisees.

steps.title: Welcome, Advisor! 🤝
steps.intro: Your AFPAConnect advisor portal helps you manage leads, match candidates to franchises, and grow your pipeline.

steps.title: Advisor Navigation
steps.intro: Everything you need is right here in the sidebar.

steps.title: My Leads
steps.intro: Track all your candidates here — see their quiz results, budget range, and where they are in the process.

steps.title: AI Tools
steps.intro: Use AI-powered matching to find the right franchises for each candidate based on their profile and quiz results.

steps.title: Settings
steps.intro: Keep your advisor profile up to date — candidates see your bio, photo, and calendar booking link.

steps.title: Let's get to work! 💼
steps.intro: You're all set. Head to My Leads to see your current pipeline, or use AI Tools to start matching a new candidate.

steps.title: Welcome, Franchise Rep! 👋
steps.intro: Your portal helps you manage leads and applications for your franchise brand.

steps.title: Navigation
steps.intro: Use the sidebar to move between your leads, applications, and settings.

steps.title: My Leads
steps.intro: View all prospects who have shown interest in your brand. Reach out and move them through your pipeline here.

steps.title: Applications
steps.intro: Review formal franchise applications and update their status as candidates progress.

steps.title: You're ready! 🎉
steps.intro: Start by checking your leads to see who's interested in your brand right now.

steps.title: Welcome to AFPAConnect! 🌟
steps.intro: We help you find the perfect franchise opportunity. Let's show you how to get started.

steps.title: Your Dashboard
steps.intro: This is your personal hub. Track your franchise research and manage your profile from here.

steps.title: Take the Franchise Quiz
steps.intro: Not sure where to start? Our quiz matches you to franchises based on your budget, lifestyle, and goals — it only takes 5 minutes.

steps.title: Browse the Directory
steps.intro: Explore hundreds of franchise opportunities. Filter by category, investment range, and business model.

steps.title: You're all set! ✨
steps.intro: Ready to find your franchise? We recommend starting with the quiz — it'll show you your best matches instantly.
